sites.name: Pu Ta Leng Peak
sites.event: The second highest mountain peak in Vietnam (3,049m), it is one of the most challenging and attractive trekking routes in the country, famous for its primeval rhododendron forest.

sites.name: O Quy Ho Pass
sites.event: One of the 'Four Great Passes' of Vietnam, where the boundary marker of the three provinces of Lai Chau, Lao Cai, and Yen Bai is located, featuring majestic landscapes and misty clouds.

sites.name: Sin Ho Plateau
sites.event: A limestone plateau with a cool climate, home to many ethnic minorities such as the Mong, Dao, Lu, and Giay, preserving unique cultural features and periodic markets.

sites.name: Tac Tinh Waterfall
sites.event: A majestic waterfall associated with the legend of a sad love story of a Thai ethnic couple, bringing wild beauty amidst the mountains and forests.

sites.name: Pu Sam Cap Cave Complex
sites.event: A large limestone cave system located inside Pu Sam Cap Mountain, including Thien Mon, Thien Duong, and Thuy Tinh caves with stalactites of various shapes.

place.commune: Nam Loong Commune, San Thang Commune

sites.name: Northwest Regional Party Committee Historical Relic Site
sites.event: The base of the Regional Party Committee, the workplace and revolutionary leadership headquarters of senior leaders of the Northwest region during the resistance war against the French.

sites.name: Muong Than Field
sites.event: The third largest rice field in the Northwest region ('First Thanh, second Lo, third Than, fourth Tac'), creating a beautiful agricultural landscape.

sites.name: Ma Lu Thang International Border Gate
sites.event: An important border gate for economic trade between Vietnam and China, located on the border of Lai Chau Province.

sites.name: Lai Chau Provincial Party Committee Historical Relic
sites.event: The base for secret activities and leading the people in the resistance war against the French (1950-1954).

sites.name: Hon Village (Thai Ethnic Village)
sites.event: An ancient village of the Thai ethnic group, which still preserves traditional stilt house architecture and unique folk festivals.

sites.name: Bach Moc Luong Tu Peak
sites.event: The fourth highest mountain peak in Vietnam (3,046m), famous for its majestic 'sea of clouds' in the early morning.
